name: Beep Notifier – Live Sales Notification for WooCommerce
author: BeepCoder

sections.description:
Beep Live Sales Notifier for WooCommerce helps boost conversions by displaying real-time sales notifications on your store. Create social proof, increase urgency, and drive more sales with this powerful plugin.

Features

Free Features

  • Display real-time WooCommerce sales notifications.
  • Customize customer name display (First Name, Full Name, etc.).
  • Enable or disable random order display.
  • Show or hide default images in notifications.
  • Choose notification position (e.g., bottom left, top right).
  • Adjust notification size.
  • Enable or disable the close button.
  • Control mobile visibility settings.
  • Configure notification timing (delay before the first notification, display duration, and interval between notifications).
  • Enable looping for continuous notifications.
  • Open links in a new tab.
  • Default animation settings for showing and hiding notifications.

Pro Features 🏆

  • Multiple themes. 🏆
  • Set an order limit for notifications. 🏆
  • Display notifications based on specific order statuses (e.g., Completed). 🏆
  • Customize notification link types. 🏆
  • Advanced visibility control (choose where notifications appear on the site). 🏆
  • Select from multiple animation effects for showing and hiding notifications. 🏆

🔹 Unlock all Pro features here: Beep Notifier Pro

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/beep-notifier/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to BeepNotifier Settings under WooCommerce and configure the notifications.
  4. Save changes and start displaying live sales notifications!
sections.faq:
How does this plugin help increase sales?

By showing recent purchases, it creates social proof and a sense of urgency, encouraging potential customers to make a purchase.

Can I customize the notification design?

Yes, you can adjust the notification position, size, animations, and visibility.

Does it work with all WooCommerce stores?

Yes, as long as you are running WordPress 5.2 or later and WooCommerce.
